items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: in Chicago I was playing with a boy named Francois Mosley and the other fella named William Hilliard. And I was in the twenties and he was playing tuba with us.

ctx.x: Well I don't know about here. Well in Chicago I was playing with a boy named Francois Mosley and the other fella named William Hilliard. And I was in the twenties and he was playing tuba with us. And he played so, man you thought it was a bass violin. He didn't play no louder than the orchestra played. Except that tuba right down there. But William Hilliard, they called him Bill Hilliard.
That's right, he's on the record with you I think. Yeah, yeah.
